reason: The reported north-only estimate reproduces (0.54, p=0.15). The north-only restriction is unjustified, but the full sample and the central and south regions give the same result. With the pre-period outcome controlled, the effect is near zero (full sample 0.06, SE 0.25). The raw correlation (1.78) is confounding, so 'no effect' is supported. The report should note that the north-only CI is wide and that the full-sample estimate is the stronger evidence.
